description: This file contains React component definitions and utilities related to rendering links, attachments, trace views, and URL navigation within a web-based test report UI. It includes components like Link, ProjectLink, AttachmentLink, and TraceLink, as well as functions for navigating and handling URL parameters.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A React component that renders children based on a URL search parameter predicate.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: A React component that renders an anchor tag with custom navigation logic.

classes.name: LinkBadge
classes.description: A styled variation of Link, displayed as a badge.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: A link component pointing to a project filter in the test report.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component for rendering a link or expandable view for test attachments.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component for rendering a link to view a trace attachment from a test.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Context provider to manage URL search parameters.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored by URL param.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Functions to change URL using history pushState and dispatch a popstate event.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: Custom hook to access current URL search parameters.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook that triggers a callback when an element is anchored via URL.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Checks if a given ID matches the current URL anchor.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Function to generate a URL hash with test ID, result index, and anchor.
